system.description:
15th Level Clan Feature

Every great composer eventually transcends the boundaries of their chosen instrument and sound. The Kashu clans mastery of sound does not end at the edge of their Branches techniques. It only expands and grows, hungrily consuming the methods of their sister branches. Select one of your sister branches. You gain access to that branches 1st and 3rd level features and can now learn jutsu with the associated branch keywords with the following limitations:

Harmonic Branch: You gain one Doki of your choice. You can summon it following the rules of the Conductors Throne clan feature. You can command it, once per turn as at no action cost. Your Doki acts on your turn. You also gain 2 Harmonies from the Harmonic Songs clan feature. These two Harmonies are always prepared for you.

Symphonic Branch: Your Shinobi Instrument can begin to store up to 2 Resonance, and can use all three Melodies in the same way that the Resonance Crown clan feature dictates. You also gain 2 Harmonies from the Symphonic Songs clan feature. These two Symphonies are always prepared for you.

Mnemonic Branch: You learn to place Bell Wires following the rules of the Bell Witch clan feature. You can maintain up to 3 Bell Wires simultaneously and place one per turn at the start of your turn as described in the Bell Witch clan feature. You also gain 2 Mnemodies from the Mnemonic Songs clan feature. These two Mnemodies are always prepared for you.
